quiet.title: Going quiet
quiet.subtitle: Active clients with no new task, approval or invoice in 30 days

info.name: Going quiet
info.definition: Active clients with no new task, no task approved and no invoice for the number of days in Settings. A client whose every retainer has ended is not quiet: they are lost, and counted there.
info.formula: count of Active clients with nothing in N days
info.period: As at the end of the period: today for the current one, the closed month's snapshot for a past one.

lost.title: Lost in the last six months
lost.subtitle: Retainers that ended to 2 Nov 2026

info.name: Lost
info.definition: Retainers that ended in the six months to the end of the period, with their reasons. One past its renewal date with nothing decided is not lost yet: it stays under renewals until somebody marks it.
info.formula: count of retainers ended in six months
info.period: As at the end of the period: today for the current one, the closed month's snapshot for a past one.
